meta.title: An amendment publish requires non-blank remarks
gaps: The available vocabulary cannot set amendment_remarks.remarks to a non-blank value for the second publish attempt.
The available EDGE-PUB-108 case expects blank amendment remarks to be accepted/no-5xx, not refused.
The setup vocabulary has no amendment-draft recipe; new_version is used to arrange the closest available state.
The successful second publish is not checked.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer issues a new version of the event.
The buyer sends the request that updates (and publishes) the event, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with a clear message, and never with a server error.
